top_signals.title: EnerVenue Signs Order with Chinese Oil Producer
top_signals.summary:
Henning Rath, CEO at battery startup EnerVenue, says the company's water-based nickel-hydrogen battery cells will be installed in an oilfield in northern China. He speaks on "Bloomberg: The China Show."
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Chinese Car Brands Hit Record European Share on Hybrid Demand
top_signals.summary: Chinese automakers grabbed another record share of Europe’s car market last month, luring buyers still wary about going fully electric with more affordable hybrid vehicles.
